intro_say: Hi friends! I'm Stompy! Let's count!

hook.line: Oh no! Stompy slipped and the eggs rolled away!
hook.line_caption:
Oh no! Stompy slipped
and the eggs rolled away!

song:
One, two, three,
four, five, yay!

Eggs that roll
and rock and sway!

Six, seven, eight,
nine and ten,

Ten eggs safe
and home again!

youtube.title: Count the Dino Eggs with Stompy! (OOPS!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🥚 OOPS! Stompy the dino slipped in the jungle and all the colorful eggs rolled away! Can you help Stompy count them back?

Count from 1 to 10 with Stompy, the nerdiest dinosaur in the jungle! Each egg comes back one by one with its number and its word. Then sing the egg counting song with Stompy, and stay till the end... something is going CRACK! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Count from 1 to 10
✔️ See each number and its word (1 = ONE)
✔️ Spot bright colors on every egg
✔️ Sing an egg counting song with Stompy!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Stompy!
0:04 OOPS! Oh no!
0:09 Let's count the eggs!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 What is that crack?
0:56 Name the surprise!

💬 What would you name the baby dino? Tell Stompy in the comments!
